# Third-party material: not covered by this repository's license

The `*.runtime.css` files here are style rules that Microsoft Outlook on the web generated in a
browser at runtime, captured alongside scrubbed page snapshots (see `docs/capturing-pages.md`).
They are Microsoft's work. This project claims no ownership of them, and the repository's MIT
license does not apply to them.

They are kept only so that tests and screenshots render fixtures the way Outlook does. They are
not part of the extension, are never shipped in it, and are not offered for any other use.

If you are a rights holder and want them removed, open an issue and they will be taken out.
